column1: # lane/chainfuzz3: chained human-play fuzzing with gen.py kits (csrc/tests/playfuzz/chain.sh), 2026-09-28

column6: cause

the join's forceSpawn vehicle reaches the client before its chunk, so its copy sits in ChunkProviderClient's EmptyChunk (addedToChunk false) and skips its first update; native moved it (g11:7011 s4, chainfuzz2's open item)
EntityPlayerSP applies the item-use slowdown only when not riding; native slowed a riding player drinking a potion (fresh:208 s7, chainfuzz2's open item)

a TNT read back from the save has no placer (tntPlacedBy is not saved; the snapshot's e:-1), so the blast's damage source has no entity; native read any e: reference as the player and knocked the pig back with a Random draw (g8:5008 s6, chainfuzz2's open item)
a player that died riding leaves loadedEntityList at its own entry in the same pass when its vehicle, ticked first, let go of it; native waited a tick
the respawned EntityClientPlayerMP rides nothing; native's fresh client player kept the dead one's vehicle and snapped back onto it (pinned by pfc-deadrider-s6)
a snapshot with a large fireball in flight: its S0E waiting in the client's queue was not built, and its tracker entry was not restored, so the entry spawned it a second time

a fireball read back from a save has no shooter: causeFireballDamage(this, null) makes the fireball the source entity, the knockback's origin; native took the no-entity branch's Math.random yaw (pinned by pfc-fireballjoin-f305)
each EntityLivingBase.onEntityUpdate block asks isEntityAlive again: a suffocation hit that kills refills the air; native decremented it
the End's explosion entity query left out the falling and hanging entities, so a TNT blast did not push a leash knot

slotClick's putStack(null) test reads the stack object Java holds: native tested a freed copy's count (always 0) when merging the merchant's result onto the cursor, so a merchant reset drew the villager's yes sound before useRecipe

a riding player's processPlayer moves the player manager before its updateEntity, whose chunk sends start the tracker watching what stands in them the same tick; native moved it after (also s3:11103 s5)
EntityCreature.updateLeashedState acts only on a holder in the same world: a mob leashed to a knot that went through a portal pathed toward it (loading chunks) and dropped its lead
the server player's movementSpeed attribute follows its potion modifiers; native re-derived it only on a sprint change, so a Speed drunk mid-session did not reach the server's ground movement
a slime's split children join loadedEntityList and count toward the natural spawner's IMob cap; native never counted them and ran an extra spawn pass
the respawned EntityPlayerMP starts with a fresh portal state; native kept the cooldown of a player that died in a Nether portal
a villager read back from a region keeps its Offers; the region reader skipped them (also s6:11306 s7)

transferEntityToWorld's placing half (placeInPortal, spawnEntityInWorld) runs only for an entity alive: a player dead in the End portal is moved but builds no platform and is in no world's lists until the respawn

the client's EntityItem.onUpdate push-out query (func_147461_a) reaches a brewing stand, whose addCollisionBoxesToList leaves the shared Block bounds at its 1/8 base, which the next pick and placement read; native's client item copies run no physics
a villager killed by a zombie outside the overworld turns into a zombie villager there; native's infection returned outside the overworld

a portal traveller's old instance stays in the destination chunk's list when the rest of its update moves it off that chunk (the source world's chunk check retargets or clears its membership), and findNearestEntityWithinAABB takes dead entities: a villager watched that ghost
a falling block's moveEntity walk reaches BlockEndPortal and travels to the End (the platform built, a copy on it); native had no falling-block portal travel

an arrow a skeleton shot (and any plain arrow spawn) had no world back-pointer natively, so its End portal hook did nothing; the play binary's inputs then left the Java replay (ORACLE DIVERGE at 1073)

EffectRenderer.addBlockHitEffects places the particle in double arithmetic over (double)0.1F; native used the double 0.1, leaving the particle 1.5e-9 past the dug face so it slid past the end stone, came to rest a block higher and touched a brewing stand placed later, whose shared bounds changed early and moved the client's next pick
